title: jira-management project-tier configuration
description: Schema for the 'jira' block the skill owns inside {PROJECT_AGENTS}/project/.local-config.json (and per-environment overrides under {PROJECT_AGENTS}/project/environments/{env}/). api_token is sensitive: never echo it, never commit the file.

base_url.description: Jira Cloud site root, no trailing slash or path — e.g. https://yourcompany.atlassian.net

email.description: Login email paired with the API token for basic auth.

api_token.description: SENSITIVE. Jira API token from https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Never echo, log, or commit.

project_prefixes.description: Jira project keys recognised as ticket prefixes (e.g. DTT-115). Populated during install step 5.

allowed_methods.description: Project-tier method scope chosen at install step 4. Missing or empty means ["GET"] (read-only) — never 'everything'. Only the user may widen this, via the re-scoping flow.

allowed_operations.description: Optional finer-grained whitelist. Each entry is 'METHOD /path' (e.g. 'POST /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/comment') or an operationId from references/api-reference.md. When non-empty, a write call must match BOTH allowed_methods and this list. GET is never restricted by this list.
